description: Shared definitions for Linked Data lexicons (proposal §3). DRAFT.

ref.description: A reference to another resource. Pinned when 'cid' is present (proposal §6.7); compatible with com.atproto.repo.strongRef.

uri.description: An at:// URI, or any other URI for references across transports.

cid.description: CID of the pinned version of the target: the record's CID for an at:// URI; otherwise the CID of the target's bytes (raw codec, sha-256), as for blobs.

decimal.description: Lexical form of an xsd:decimal, e.g. '-0.42'. Non-integer numbers are strings, since the ATProto data model has no floats (proposal §3 rule 10).

double.description: Lexical form of an xsd:double, e.g. '1.5E3', 'INF', 'NaN' (proposal §3 rule 10).
